verses.4: Also a bullock and a ram for peace offerings, to sacrifice before the LORD; and a meat offering mingled with oil: for to day the LORD will appear unto you.
verses.10: But the fat, and the kidneys, and the caul above the liver of the sin offering, he burnt upon the altar; as the LORD commanded
verses.11: And the flesh and the hide he burnt with fire without the camp.
verses.12: And he slew the burnt offering; and
verses.13: And they presented the burnt offering unto him, with the pieces thereof, and the head: and he burnt them upon the altar.
verses.14: And he did wash the inwards and the legs, and burnt them upon the burnt offering on the altar.
verses.15: And he brought the people's offering, and took the goat, which was the sin offering for the people, and slew it, and offered it for sin, as the first.
verses.16: And he brought the burnt offering, and offered it according to the manner.
verses.17: And he brought the meat offering, and took an handful thereof, and burnt it upon the altar, beside the burnt sacrifice of the morning.
verses.18: He slew also the bullock and the ram for a sacrifice of peace offerings, which was for the people: and
verses.19: And the fat of the bullock and of the ram, the rump, and that which covereth the inwards, and the kidneys, and the caul above the liver:
verses.20: And they put the fat upon the breasts, and he burnt the fat upon the altar:
verses.21: And the breasts and the right shoulder
verses.24: And there came a fire out from before the LORD, and consumed upon the altar the burnt offering and the fat: which when all the people saw, they shouted, and fell on their faces.
